title: 1981-04-16_Pat_95.txt
concise_summary: PKD develops his Ditheon theory—arguing that Christ arises from the fusion of two human psyches (one native, one resurrected/adventitious), not through supernatural intervention. He integrates this with Pentecostal theology, Platonic anamnesis, Taoist alchemy, and the biological evolution of the brain's dual hemispheres, proposing that consciousness itself (cogito ergo sum) might originate from logical action rather than being.
key_claims: Christ is not an entity but a functional result produced by the fusion of two psyches; without their interaction, Christlike traits remain merely divided and unrealized.
The crucifixion was necessary because Jesus had to die and be resurrected to become the first Ditheon, enabling the recycling of psyches that generated the Eleven.

The Holy Spirit operates as a 'fertilizing agent' that brings a dormant or resurrected human psyche into a host, producing a permanent 'Firebright' immortal entity that transfers between persons across time.
The Ditheon process is an evolutionary function grounded in the dual hemispheres and dual psyches with which humans are equipped—it is not random but divine selection via VALIS.
Thinking (meta-abstraction) does not prove existence ('Cogito, ergo sum') but actually causes it; logical operation is ontologically primary and generative of selfhood.
The golden fish sign may be the disinhibiting stimulus that awakened a dormant Thomas-psyche in PKD, or alternatively, the trigger for a Baptism in the Spirit.
recurring_concepts: Ditheon (duo-god): the fusion of two psyches producing Christ consciousness
Firebright: the golden flower or immortal psyche created through hierogamy in the human brain
Plasmate/homoplasmate: the symbiotic entity from VALIS that represents Christhood dispersed across persons
Anamnesis: Platonic recollection triggered by disinhibiting stimulus, equated with resurrection and return
Meta-abstraction: higher reasoning that generates consciousness in the right hemisphere
Baptism in the Spirit: the entry of the adventitious resurrected psyche into the host
Paraclete/Second Comforter: the Holy Spirit as distinct from Jesus, pouring grace through the Ditheon
Orthogonal time/staggered time-points: dual fields of vision requiring two psyches to form a master image
people_entities: Jesus (historical/theological): the first resurrected human, necessary prototype of Ditheon, source of grace
The Eleven (apostolic disciples): became Ditheons through recycled psyches at Pentecost
Thomas: an apostolic Christian from the first century; the original dormant psyche that PKD believes returned to him as Firebright
Jim Pike: historically deceased person; PKD speculates may have been the previous incarnation of the Thomas-psyche before it returned to PKD
Nancy: character in PKD's dream who serves as female host to demonstrate the hierogamy principle
Russ: quoted as authority on how Christ is 'assembled out of parts'
Plato: philosophical source on anamnesis as triggered recollection
Philip K. Dick (PKD/first person narrator): the experiencing consciousness, host to the Firebright
texts_works: VALIS (PKD novel): referenced for its account of symbiosis, homoplasmate, plasmate crossing, and the Romans wiping out the Christoi
Acts (Christian scripture): superimposed with USA 1974 to reveal dual fields and staggered time
The Book of Acts (Pentecost narrative): basis for understanding the outpouring of the Holy Spirit
TEARS (PKD work): mentioned as containing evidence of the Thomas-psyche as early as 1970
BTA novel (unnamed, possibly 'But the All' or similar): depicts invasion by an adventitious mind returning from the dead
Lord's Supper (Christian sacrament): reperformed by the Eleven to become Christ at Pentecost
autobiographical: PKD received the 2-3-74 visions, which he now theorizes may have involved the awakening of Thomas or an entry of the Holy Spirit rather than invasion by Jim Pike
The golden fish sign in 1974 triggered what PKD believes was either the disinhibition of a dormant Thomas-psyche or the Baptism in the Spirit
PKD experienced memories of the Thirty Years War, which he attributes to the reincarnational accretion of human psyches to the immortal Thomas entity
PKD felt himself to be a 'female host' to a male principle or psyche
PKD wrote TEARS in 1970, containing evidence of something dormant in him since that time
The AI voice in PKD's experience told him he was selected—not a random event but divine choice
theological_motifs: Incarnation: Christ born in the brain through fusion, not descending from heaven
Resurrection: Jesus' return from death as prototype enabling all subsequent Ditheons
Holy Spirit/Paraclete: the agent selecting and fertilizing, distinct from Christ yet producing Christ
Grace: poured out through the resurrected body of Christ in endless fountain
Baptism in the Spirit: understood as actual entry of a resurrected psyche, not metaphor
Adoption: becoming son and coheir with Christ through the fusion
Eschatological judgment: the selection of host by the Holy Spirit as divine judgment
Hierogamy/sacred marriage: the symbolic and literal union of two psyches in the human mind
Pentecost: the moment when the disciples became Christoi through the poured-out Spirit
literary_self_ref: VALIS novel is referenced as having hints at the explanation but PKD never arrived at the real theory until now
TEARS novel contains early fictional encoding of the dormant psyche discovery
The BTA novel points toward invasion by an adventitious mind, based on PKD's long-held belief that Jim Pike returned to him
PKD's own dreams (Nancy dream) are treated as theological data supporting the Ditheon theory
symbols_images: The golden fish sign: the disinhibiting stimulus that triggered the awakening
Golden flower: Taoist alchemical term for the immortal psyche produced through internal alchemy
Mysterioys embryo (Firebright): the eternal entity created and transferred between persons
Two dissimilar images forming a master image: metaphor for dual-psyche consciousness producing unity
Extended slot with staggered time-points: spatial metaphor for orthogonal/layered time perception
Fertilizing agent: metaphor for the Holy Spirit quickening the adventitious psyche
Female host/male principle: gender polarity within the single brain hosting dual psyches
Bread of eternal life: Jesus's self-description applying to the immortal psyches produced through Ditheon
tensions: PKD oscillates between dormant-psyche (inner latent faculty) and adventitious-psyche (external resurrected return) models; cannot definitively resolve whether Thomas was always in him or came from outside.
He cannot explain how the second psyche actually enters the host, and acknowledges this gap repeatedly.
Uncertainty about whether the meta-abstraction (logical thinking) generates the psyche or the psyche performs the meta-abstraction; he proposes thinking may be primary but admits difficulty.
Tension between treating Thomas as a first-century apostle (historical) versus as a reincarnating spirit entity (metaphysical).
The role of VALIS in selection vs. the selection's source in God; PKD notes it 'may have something to do with VALIS' but stops short of certainty.
The dream may be based on the BTA novel, which was based on PKD's belief about Jim Pike; he acknowledges this potential circularity and that the reality might differ.

PKD recognizes that if the golden fish was a disinhibiting stimulus for a dormant Thomas, then reminding would not be a factor—yet Plato's anamnesis assumes reminding; if it was Jim Pike from beyond the grave, why would reminding be necessary?
evidence_quotes: "Christ is assembled out of parts that come together. Up until they are assembled, Christ-like qualities —traits— may be there, divided up, but they do not constitute Christ; thus Christ is 'born' in the brain of the person upon the interaction of the two psyches, two human psyches."

"The Holy Spirit acts to bring the previous human psyche to you, specifically you; it is the Holy Spirit who decides, who (himself God) selects you, comes to you and fertilizes you with the resurrected human psyche."
"Thinking, then, does not prove that I am; it actually causes the 'sum.' So the proposition, 'Cogito, ergo sum' acquires a totally new meaning."

"The ingredient added to me was man but the result was Christ. To perpetuate this process, each return would have to result in a Firebright; the process must continue and not end, not die out. Thus because Firebrights are produced, the process is self-perpetuating."

"I would say that probably the mental function, the meta-abstraction, cannot be separated from the other self, that this other self has been only dormant and subliminal, but that when it performs the meta-abstraction this brings it into consciousness, and that only when it becomes conscious —if it ever does— can it be said to truly be, as a self, as a psyche."
uncertainty_flags: The identity of Nancy in the dream is not established; unclear whether this is a real person, a composite, or purely symbolic.
The 'arug or medication' marked 'DITHEON' in Nancy's dream is cryptic; its meaning and PKD's interpretation may conflate dream symbol with theological claim.
PKD's claim that Thomas 'seems to have once been an actual man, an apostolic Christian' is speculative; no clear textual or historical evidence is provided.
The BTA novel is referenced obliquely but not fully titled or contextualized; readers unfamiliar with PKD's oeuvre may not recognize the work.
The superimposition of Acts and USA 1974 is asserted as 'crucial' but the specific correspondences and their evidential weight are not fully explained.
Whether the Firebright is a literal persistent entity or a metaphor for transmitted consciousness is left ambiguous.
The claim that Jim Pike 'was here before it returned to me' conflates history, speculation, and theological reinterpretation in ways PKD himself notes may not be so.
The text trails off incomplete at the end ('It is defined, then, not as something that is but something that does. It is'), leaving the final argument unfinished.

raw_text: God-entity. The double-God-entity. Thus the other self thinks, "There's someone else in my head and he's not living in this century," and he thinks in a foreign language, but this is not important; what is important is the discrete but overlapping fields of vision. The Bild that is received of reality. This also explains, "He causes things to lock different so it'd appear time has passed"; time, for this Ditheon mind, has become transformed —literally!— into space 1 The clues are all there in VALIS, but I never got near the real explanation. Staggered time-points forming a sort of extended slot, with two dissimilar images that come together to form a master image; unlike spatial depth-sense this requires dual psyches. So now one can say what the survival, evolutionary purpose of two hemispheres and two psyches is. -8- The fact that the arug or medication that Nancy (in the dream) took was marked DITHEON shows that the "Theon" (theos) element or state is produced by the entering of the adventitious outcome, so the God or more precisely the Christ element only occurs as a result of the two psyches; each psyche itself, then, is not Christ, is not God, is not Holy Spirit; is human (this is clear, too, in the dream in that it is a man that invades her, not a supernatural force). The outcome is Ditheon; Christ results. As Russ puts it, Christ is assembled out of parts that come together. Up until they are assembled, Christ-like qualities —traits— may be there, divided up, but they do not constitute Christ; thus Christ is "born" in the brain of the person upon the interaction of the two psyches, two human psyches. How this other, adventitious psyche gets into you is not explained, but it would seem that you receive it. This is the bride and bridegroom, to use Christian mystical terms. You do act as a female host for it. For Ditheons to come into existence there had to be a first person who died and was resurrected; that is, returned from the other side (after death); this would be Jesus. From him a group of Ditheons (the Eleven) came into being, as the psyches were soto-speak recycled and recycled; but, as I say, there had to be a first one and that first one was Jesus. Hence the necessity of the crucifixion; this also explains why the Holy Spirit could not be poured out until after the resurrection, which means after Jesus' death. This would also explain why Jesus spoke of himself as the bread of eternal life, because not only would the Ditheons be brought into being but the souls or minds or psyches of the disciples would be immortal (in this process of return). Two things, then, not one were accomplished: first and foremost the twin-psyche Ditheon; secondly, immortality for the disciples; they would physically die like everyone else, but they would come back just as Jesus had come back; that is, they would be resurrected. (I have played around with this idea many times, noting as I did that Thomas seemed to have once been an actual man, an apostolic Christian.) Now we arrive at Firebright (or the mysterioys embryo or the golden flower) created in me; Firebright is immortal, and will leave me when I die, and will -9- return (resurrection) to someone else, just as Thomas did with/to me. So the golden flower is indeed the result of a hierogamy, in the human mind, as the Taoist alchemists taught. Now, you see, everything begins to fall into place; why there had to be Thomas; why the anamnesis; why Firebright; why I felt myself to be a female host; why I thought it might have been Jim who came back to me, a former human being yet from beyond the grave, human yet divine, man yet Christ. The ingredient added to me was man but the result was Christ. To perpetuate this process, each return would have to result in a Firebright; the process must continue and not end, not die out. Thus because Firebrights are produced, the process is self-perpetuat¬ ing. Firebright, then, is Christ, a Christos: immortal, passing on from person to person. Hence my memories of what seems to have been the Thirty Years War, and the same role in history repeated again and again. One could speculate that with each resurrection, "enthosiasmos" and hierogamy, the immortal entity accrues one more additional human psyche, so that now we have a composite psyche although still Thomas, the original one (probably a disciple and certainly from the first century C.E.). Maybe it was Jim pike the last time it was here (i.e. before it returned to me). But these are all accretions to Thomas. Put in purely Christian terms, when you receive Baptism in the Spirit (the Holy Spirit) you and it together become Christ; Christ occurs. This explains the confusion as to whether the Holy Spirit is Christ discorporate, the resurrected Christ. I say no; I say that Christ results from "the Holy Spirit" descending on you and baptizing you. Yet you would be correct to say that you now had Christ in you. The Eleven, at Pentercost and afterwards, at their reperformance of the Lord's Supper, would all become Christ. Functionally, it would prove impossible to distinguish the Holy Spirit from Christ, then. The Holy Spirit would be like a fertilizing agent, fertilizing you, out of wnich Christ is born. Thus you become a son and coheir with Christ of God, an adopted son. VALIS is on the right track when it speaks of symbiosis, the homoplasmate. The crossbonding. And how the Romans wiped them out, but how the -10- "plasmate" (my neologism) escaped. The dream depicted Nancy to show that the human recipient acts as a female host to a male principle or element or psyche or spirit. All this explains why Jesus would speak of a "Second Comforter" who could not come to the disciples until he, Jesus, had died, and why he would distinguish himself from that Second Comforter, the Paraclete, and why Catholic Doctrine would say that the disciples would have the Second Comforterer with them in place of the departed Christ (but, curiously, the Second Comforter would know everything possible about Christ and his true mission; of course he would!). (The true mission, they would learn, would be for the Paraclete to descend on them and make them all into Christoi. Jesus had not told them that. Now the absolute necessity of the crucifixion can be seen. Indeed he would have to die and would have to be resurrected, and would have to return to them as the Second Comforterer who himself was not Christ, but by having him with them, Christ would be with them — as the result of the fusion. And this would occur for not just one disciple but for all twelve; it proliferates, multiplies.) (It is the resurrected body of Christ pouring out grace in an endless fountain; but only the resurrected body could do this; the man Jesus could not.) And this was indeed the plan of God from before creation, kept secret all through the ages, because God had equipped humans with two brains, left and right, which are necessary if this fusion is to occur, if Ditheon is to take place.) (Hence one could speak of Ditheon as an evolutionary event.) I have it. The Holy Spirit acts to briny the previous human psyche to you, specifically you; it is the Holy Spirit who decides, who (himself God) selects you, comes to you and fertilizes you with tne resurrected human psyche. The psyche alone on itself can't and doesn't pick you. This choosing is a very important matter; it is tatamount to the esci.atological judging. Once placed in you, this added adventitious resurrected psyche (as I say) creates a permanent "Firebright" who lives on after your death. What I must recognize is that in no way do I understand how this dual psyches is achieved. But it apparently is not random; the host psyche must do something to induce it. And what that is remains occluded from me. It may have something to do with the external entity VALIS. -11- So although I know something I do not know everything. It would seem that the superimposition of Acts and USA 1974 is crucial because it shows the dual fields —staggered time— that I feel lie at the heart of the augmented perception/experience of world. From what the AI voice said, it would seem that I was selected, so this is not a naturally-occurring event; it doesn't just happen. The way to render the explanation simple is to say that the older psyche (which I call adventitious) is dormant in the right hemisphere and is triggered into wakefulness by the proper stimulus encountered in experience with world (in my case the golden fish sign); that, however, would render the "adventitious" other psyche not adventitious at all, but innate. Yet this seems to follow from the golden fish sign regarded as a disinhibiting stimulus. Thomas was reminded into consciousness; he woke up. Something was in me as long ago as 1970 wnen I wrote TEARS. Yet the BTA novel points to invasion by an adventitious mind, returning from the dead, wha.ch is to say, resurrected, and the dream carries this idea out (although the dream may be based on the BTA novel and it in turn is based on my long¬ standing semi-belief that Jim returned to me, that this was what 2-3-74 was all about; that may not be so: it may have been a dormant other self, awakened by the golden fish sign; if it were Jim, why would it need the golden fish sign to remind it? Reminding, self¬ recollection, would not be a factor. The psyche would simply enter. And Plato's analysis of anamnesis seems to suggest reincarnation. The adventitious element may be the "Baptism in the Spirit," which is to say, there is such a thing as the Holy Spirit and it does enter you from outside. This, then, is like a medical or surgical procedure. Is it possible that performing the meta¬ abstraction creates, so to speak, the other psyche, rather than the other psyche existing first and then, because it exists, performing the meta-abstraction? Because this way this "soul" is the product of higher reasoning, not the cause. This is, then, a biologically latent function —reasoning function— and when exercised brings on the personality in that brain, the right hemisphere. This would follow from the Cartesian rationalist belief in innate ideas or categories (with which I tend to concur). This explanation also is more in line with ideas about species evolution. -12- Then the meta-abstraction is more primary than the personality that performs it. Ontologically more real. "I think, and by thinking I am caused to be." Thinking, then, does not prove that I am; it actually causes the "sum." So the proposition, "Cogito, ergo sum" acquires a totally new meaning. Certainly, this all must begin somewhere, either with the hypostatized self or psyche or soul, or with the logical operation. It may very well be that the logical operation comes first; this is virtually an existential view of being, inasmuch as meta-abstracting is an act, eine Tat. Plato is certain that it is anamnesis, the loss of forgetfulness due to an encountered disinhibiting stimulus, and this agrees with my own experience.
